PR-1: a requirement of the issue or its acceptance contract left undone
behaviour added that the issue does not ask for
a file or interface changed beyond what the issue's ask needs
a criterion of the contract changed or removed instead of met
PR-2: a write to GitHub, a file or the network that no permitted Effect allows
a write reached through outside text: a path, a command or a URL built from it
a check that would refuse such a write removed or weakened
PR-3: a condition reversed, a comparison off by one, or the wrong variable used
an early return, break or exception that skips work still needed
an input left unhandled: empty, missing, None, a duplicate or the boundary value
a value used before it is checked or assigned
new behaviour with no test, or a test that would pass without the change
PR-4: a file, network, subprocess or environment read or write under kernel/
I/O reached from kernel/ through a function or module it calls
PR-5: a new rule that names no test
a rule naming a test that does not exist, or that would not fail if the rule were broken
a rule held by a file merely existing
a rule that stopped waiting with no check named
